```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

set.seed(42)
analysis_start_time <- Sys.time()
message("Starting RNA-seq WWTR1 overexpression analysis at: ", analysis_start_time)
```

## Configuration and Setup

```{r configuration}
config <- list(
  filtering = list(
    abs_filt_samples = 2,
    min_count_threshold = 10
  ),
  statistical = list(
    padj_cutoff = 0.05,
    log2FC_cutoff = 1,
    var_expl_needed = 0.6
  ),
  visualization = list(
    ntop_genes_pca = 1000,
    plot_width = 20,
    plot_height = 20,
    plot_units = "cm",
    top_pathways_show = 20
  ),
  fgsea = list(
    min_size = 15,
    max_size = 500
  )
)

PATHS <- list(
  data_dir = here::here("data", "RNAseq"),
  results_dir = here::here("results", "RNA-seq", "RNA-seq_TDI"),
  resources_dir = here::here("resources"),
  cache_dir = here::here("cache")
)

print("Configuration loaded successfully")
```

```{r load_libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  # Core analysis packages
  library(DESeq2)
  library(stringr)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  
  # Enrichment analysis
  library(fgsea)
  library(hypeR)
  library(GSVA)
  
  # Visualization
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  
  # Data manipulation
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  
  # Batch correction
  library(limma)
  
  # File operations
  library(openxlsx)
  library(openxlsx2)
  library(here)
  
  # Load all utility functions from consolidated script
  source(here::here("resources/UtilityScriptsRNA-seq.R"))
})

print("Libraries loaded successfully")
```

```{r setup_environment}
if(!dir.exists(PATHS$results_dir)) dir.create(PATHS$results_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Load gene sets 
message("Loading gene sets from MSigDB...")
gene_sets <- list(
  hallmark = hypeR::msigdb_gsets("Homo sapiens", "H", clean = TRUE),
  kegg = hypeR::msigdb_gsets("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:KEGG_LEGACY", clean = TRUE),
  reactome = hypeR::msigdb_gsets("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:REACTOME", clean = TRUE),
  gobp = hypeR::msigdb_gsets("Homo sapiens", "C5", "GO:BP", clean = TRUE),
  gocc = hypeR::msigdb_gsets("Homo sapiens", "C5", "GO:CC", clean = TRUE),
  gomf = hypeR::msigdb_gsets("Homo sapiens", "C5", "GO:MF", clean = TRUE),
  oncogenic = hypeR::msigdb_gsets("Homo sapiens", "C6", clean = TRUE),
  wang_hippo = list(genesets = list(wang_hippo_set = c("CCN1", "CCN2", "AMOTL2", "ANKRD1", "IGFBP3", "F3", "FJX1", "NUAK2", "LATS2", "CRIM1", "GADD45A","TGFB2", "PTPN14", "NT5E", "FOXF2", "AXL", "DOCK5", "ASAP1", "RBMS3", "MYOF", "ARHGEF17", "CCDC80")))
)

```


## Data Loading and Preparation

```{r load_data}
message("Loading RNA-seq WWTR1 overexpression data...")

annotation_data <- read.table(
  file = file.path(PATHS$data_dir, "rnaseq_deseq_global_annotation_gene.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
)
colnames(annotation_data)[c(5, 7)] <- c("ensembl_id", "gene_symbol")

#loading the new DESeq2 file
load(file.path(PATHS$data_dir, "deseq2.dds.RData"))
TDI_dds <- dds[,
                  c(
                    "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_RNA_S165191",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_RNA_S165189",
                    "OE_WWTR1_TDI_RNA_S165188",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_RNA_S165178",
                    "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep1_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep1_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep1_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep1_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep3_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep3_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep3",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep3_1",
                    "SH_A_RNA_S130494",
                    "SH_M_RNA_S130497",
                    "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep1_1",
                    "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep2_1",
                    "SK_N_SH_MES_rep1_1",
                    "SK_N_SH_MES_rep2_1"
                  )]

rm(dds)

message("Selected ", ncol(TDI_dds), " samples for analysis")

TDI_dds$treatment <- as.factor(case_when(
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("OE_WWTR1_DMSO_RNA_S165191",
                            "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep3_1") ~ "DMSO",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("OE_WWTR1_dox_RNA_S165189",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep3") ~ "dox",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("OE_WWTR1_TDI_RNA_S165188",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep3_1") ~ "TDI",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_RNA_S165178",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep3_1") ~ "dox_TDI",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c( "SH_A_RNA_S130494",
                             "SH_M_RNA_S130497",
                             "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep1_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep2_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_MES_rep1_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_MES_rep2_1") ~ "NO_treatment",
  .default = colnames(TDI_dds)
))

TDI_dds$genotype <- as.factor(case_when(
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("OE_WWTR1_DMSO_RNA_S165191",
                            "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep3_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_RNA_S165189",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep3",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_RNA_S165188",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep3_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_RNA_S165178",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep3_1") ~ "OE_WWTR1",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c( "SH_A_RNA_S130494",
                             "SH_M_RNA_S130497",
                             "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep1_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep2_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_MES_rep1_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_MES_rep2_1") ~ "WT",
  .default = colnames(TDI_dds)
))

TDI_dds$cell_type <- as.factor(case_when(
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("OE_WWTR1_DMSO_RNA_S165191",
                            "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep3_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_RNA_S165189",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep3",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_RNA_S165188",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep3_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_RNA_S165178",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep3_1") ~ "undefined",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c( "SH_A_RNA_S130494",
                             "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep1_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep2_1") ~ "ADR",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c( "SK_N_SH_MES_rep1_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_MES_rep2_1",
                             "SH_M_RNA_S130497") ~ "MES",
  .default = colnames(TDI_dds)
))

TDI_dds$batch <- as.factor(case_when(
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c( "SH_A_RNA_S130494",
                             "SH_M_RNA_S130497"
                             ) ~ "batch1",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("OE_WWTR1_DMSO_RNA_S165191",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_RNA_S165189",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_RNA_S165188",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_RNA_S165178"
                            ) ~ "batch2",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep3_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep3",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep3_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep1_1",
                            "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep3_1"
                            ) ~ "batch3.1",
  colnames(TDI_dds) %in%  c("SK_N_SH_ADR_rep1_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep2_1",
                            "SK_N_SH_MES_rep1_1",
                             "SK_N_SH_MES_rep2_1"
                             ) ~ "bathc3.2",
  .default = colnames(TDI_dds)
))

data.frame(TDI_dds$sample, TDI_dds$cell_type, TDI_dds$treatment, TDI_dds$genotype, TDI_dds$batch)

design(TDI_dds) <- as.formula("~ batch + treatment")

TDI_dds_backup <- TDI_dds
# For now we exclude the old samples
TDI_dds <- TDI_dds[,
                  c(
                    "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_RNA_S165191",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_RNA_S165189",
                    "OE_WWTR1_TDI_RNA_S165188",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_RNA_S165178",
                    "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep1_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep1_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep1_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep1_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep3_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep3_1",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep3",
                    "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep3_1"
                  )]

TDI_dds$treatment <- droplevels(TDI_dds$treatment)
TDI_dds$genotype <- droplevels(TDI_dds$genotype)
TDI_dds$cell_type <- droplevels(TDI_dds$cell_type)
TDI_dds$batch <- droplevels(TDI_dds$batch)

```

```{r Process the data, include=FALSE}
# Filtering lowly expressed genes
TDI_dds_filt <- filterDatasets(TDI_dds,
                               abs_filt = TRUE,
                               abs_filt_samples = config$filtering$abs_filt_samples
)

# Estimate size factors and running DESEQ2
TDI_dds_filt <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(TDI_dds_filt)
TDI_dds_filt <- DESeq2::DESeq(TDI_dds_filt)
resultsNames(TDI_dds_filt)
```

```{r Get DEGs, include=FALSE}
deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO <- generateResults(
  dds_object = TDI_dds_filt,
  coeff_name = "treatment_TDI_vs_DMSO",
  cond_numerator = "TDI",
  cond_denominator = "DMSO",
  cond_variable = "treatment",
  ensemblAnnot = annotation_data,
  log2FC_cutoff = config$statistical$log2FC_cutoff
)

# Write the result to the xlsx file
XLSX_OUT <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "results_signif")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "de_details")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "results_all")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO$results_signif, sheet = "results_signif")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO$de_details, sheet = "de_details")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO$results_all, sheet = "results_all")
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(XLSX_OUT, file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "treatment_TDI_vs_DMSO.xlsx"), overwrite = T)

deg_results_doxTDI_vs_dox <- generateResults(
  dds_object = TDI_dds_filt,
  coef_contrast=c("treatment", "dox_TDI", "dox"),
  cond_numerator = "dox_TDI",
  cond_denominator = "dox",
  cond_variable = "treatment",
  ensemblAnnot = annotation_data,
  log2FC_cutoff = config$statistical$log2FC_cutoff
)

# Write the result to the xlsx file
XLSX_OUT <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "results_signif")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "de_details")
openxlsx::addWorksheet(XLSX_OUT, "results_all")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results_doxTDI_vs_dox$results_signif, sheet = "results_signif")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results_doxTDI_vs_dox$de_details, sheet = "de_details")
openxlsx::writeData(XLSX_OUT, x = deg_results_doxTDI_vs_dox$results_all, sheet = "results_all")
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(XLSX_OUT, file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "treatment_doxTDI_vs_dox.xlsx"), overwrite = T)
```

```{r PCA visualisation, include=FALSE}
# Stabilize variance
TDI_dds_filt_vsd <- DESeq2::vst(TDI_dds_filt, blind = TRUE) # blind = TRUE for QC

# generate PCA plots
tmp_pca_deg <- generatePCA(
  transf_object = TDI_dds_filt_vsd,
  cond_interest_varPart = c("cell_type", "treatment"),
  color_variable = "cell_type",
  shape_variable = "treatment",
  ntop_genes = 1000
) + ggtitle("PCA plot for dox doxTDI DMSO TDI WWTR1 only")
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "PCA_WWTR1_only_dox_doxTDI_DMSO.pdf"),
  plot = tmp_pca_deg,
  width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm"
)

```

```{r plot PCA}
plot(tmp_pca_deg)
```

```{r perform fgsea analysis for TDI_vs_DMSO }
gene_sets
gene_sets$wang_hippo

gene_set_list <- list(
  GOBP_Hippo_Signaling = gene_sets$gobp[["genesets"]][["Hippo Signaling"]],
  REACTOME_Signaling_By_Hippo = gene_sets$reactome[["genesets"]][["Signaling By Hippo"]],
  C6_onko_Cordenonsi_Yap_Conserved_Signature = gene_sets$oncogenic[["genesets"]][["Cordenonsi Yap Conserved Signature"]],
  Hippo_Wang = gene_sets$wang_hippo[["genesets"]][["wang_hippo_set"]]
)

# TDI_vs_DMSO
deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked <- deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO$results_all
deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked <- deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  slice_max(baseMean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked <- deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked %>% arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))
deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked <- setNames(c(deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked$log2FoldChange),
                                           c(deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked$gene_symbol))
deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked <- deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked[-c(which(is.na(names(deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked))))]

fgseaRes_TDI_vs_DMSO <- fgsea(
  pathways = gene_set_list,
  stats = deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked,
  minSize = 15,
  maxSize = 500
)

for(gene_set_to_plot_name in names(gene_set_list)){
  # gene_set_to_plot_name <- "Cordenonsi_Yap_Conserved_Signature"
  gene_set_to_plot <- gene_set_list[[gene_set_to_plot_name]]
  
  title_values <- fgseaRes_TDI_vs_DMSO %>% filter(pathway == gene_set_to_plot_name) %>% dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj)
  p <- plotEnrichment(pathway = gene_set_to_plot, stats = deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO_ranked) + 
    labs(title = paste(title_values$pathway, "\n",
                       "NES =", title_values$NES, "\n",
                       "padj = ", title_values$padj))
  
 plot(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(PATHS$results_dir, paste0("TDI_vs_DMSO_fgsea_", gene_set_to_plot_name, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm"
  )
}
```

```{r Add old samples to current dataset, echo = TRUE}
# Add old ADR and MES samples for PCA visualisation
TDI_plus_OG_filt <- filterDatasets(TDI_dds_backup,

                               abs_filt_samples = config$filtering$abs_filt_samples
)
```

```{r make PCA plots with new + old samples, include = FALSE}
# generate PCA plots
tmp_pca_deg <- generatePCA(
  transf_object = TDI_plus_OG_filt_vsd,
  cond_interest_varPart = c("genotype", "treatment"),
  color_variable = "genotype",
  shape_variable = "treatment",
  ntop_genes = 1000
) +
ggtitle("dox tdi dox/tdi dmso experiment + OG samples. NOT batch corrected") 

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "PCA_WWTR1_only_dox_doxTDI_DMSO_plus_OGs.pdf"),
  plot = tmp_pca_deg,
  width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm"
)

# Batch correction
transf_batch_NObatch_experiment <- TDI_plus_OG_filt_vsd
transf_batch_NObatch_experiment_count <- limma::removeBatchEffect(SummarizedExperiment::assay(transf_batch_NObatch_experiment),
                                                                  transf_batch_NObatch_experiment$batch)
SummarizedExperiment::assay(transf_batch_NObatch_experiment) <- transf_batch_NObatch_experiment_count
pca_deg_NObatch_experiment <- generatePCA(transf_object = transf_batch_NObatch_experiment, 
                                                cond_interest_varPart = c("cell_type","treatment"), 
                                                color_variable = "cell_type", 
                                                shape_variable = "treatment",
                                                ntop_genes = 1000) +
  ggtitle("dox tdi dox/tdi dmso experiment + OG samples. batch corrected") 

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(PATHS$results_dir, "PCA_WWTR1_only_dox_doxTDI_DMSO_plus_OGs_batch_corrected.pdf"),
  plot = pca_deg_NObatch_experiment,
  width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm"
)
```

```{r GSVA with new and old samples, include=FALSE}
RNA_SEQ_data <- openxlsx2::read_xlsx("~/neuroblastoma/results/RNA-seq/RNA-seq_MES_vs_ADR/tables/MES_vs_ADR_comprehensive_results.xlsx", sheet = 2)
mes_adrn_gene_list <- RNA_SEQ_data %>%
  mutate(Term = if_else(log2FoldChange < 0, "ADRN", "MES"))
sig_list_our_data <- list(
  Aderenergic = mes_adrn_gene_list$gene_symbol[mes_adrn_gene_list$Term == "ADRN"],
  Mesenchymal = mes_adrn_gene_list$gene_symbol[mes_adrn_gene_list$Term == "MES"]
)

# prepare vsd
vsd_counts_matrix <- assay(TDI_plus_OG_filt_vsd)
gene_symbols <- annotation_data[, 'gene_symbol'][match(row.names(vsd_counts_matrix),
                                                       annotation_data[, 'ensembl_id'])]

# Drop genes without a mapped symbol
keep <- !is.na(gene_symbols) & gene_symbols != ""
vsd_counts_matrix <- vsd_counts_matrix[keep, ]
gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[keep]

# Collapse duplicate symbols: keep the row with the highest mean expression
row_means <- rowMeans(vsd_counts_matrix)
keep_idx <- order(row_means, decreasing = TRUE)
keep_idx <- keep_idx[!duplicated(gene_symbols[keep_idx])]
vsd_counts_matrix <- vsd_counts_matrix[keep_idx, ]
row.names(vsd_counts_matrix) <- gene_symbols[keep_idx]

vsd_counts_matrix <- as.matrix(vsd_counts_matrix)
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(vsd_counts_matrix))))

# Replicate groups to average (3 replicates per group)
replicate_groups <- list(
  OE_WWTR1_DMSO    = c("OE_WWTR1_DMSO_RNA_S165191",    "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep1_1",    "OE_WWTR1_DMSO_rep3_1"),
  OE_WWTR1_dox     = c("OE_WWTR1_dox_RNA_S165189",     "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep1_1",     "OE_WWTR1_dox_rep3"),
  OE_WWTR1_TDI     = c("OE_WWTR1_TDI_RNA_S165188",     "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep1_1",     "OE_WWTR1_TDI_rep3_1"),
  OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI = c("OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_RNA_S165178", "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep1_1", "OE_WWTR1_dox_TDI_rep3_1"),
  SK_N_SH_ADR      = c("SH_A_RNA_S130494",             "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep1_1",      "SK_N_SH_ADR_rep2_1"),
  SK_N_SH_MES      = c("SH_M_RNA_S130497",             "SK_N_SH_MES_rep1_1",      "SK_N_SH_MES_rep2_1")
)

# Collapse a ssGSEA score matrix to per-group means (rows = terms, cols = groups)
average_replicates <- function(mat, groups) {
  avg <- vapply(groups, function(cols) {
    cols <- intersect(cols, colnames(mat))
    rowMeans(mat[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  }, FUN.VALUE = numeric(nrow(mat)))
  rownames(avg) <- rownames(mat)
  as.matrix(avg)
}


# Plot terms based on terms defined from RNA-seq profiles obtained from our RNA seq
our_data_param <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(vsd_counts_matrix,
                                    sig_list_our_data,
                                    minSize = 1, maxSize = Inf,
                                    normalize = TRUE)
ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines <- GSVA::gsva(our_data_param,
                                      verbose = TRUE,
                                      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(10))
ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines,
                                                        scale = "row",
                                                        #annotation_col = heatmap_col_annot_DTC,
                                                        cluster_rows = TRUE,
                                                        cluster_cols = TRUE,
                                                        color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
                                                        show_colnames = TRUE)
ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap

# Averaged across replicates
ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines_avg <- average_replicates(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines, replicate_groups)
ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap_avg <- pheatmap::pheatmap(ssgsea_mes_adr_cellines_avg,
                                                            scale = "row",
                                                            #annotation_col = heatmap_col_annot_DTC,
                                                            cluster_rows = TRUE,
                                                            cluster_cols = TRUE,
                                                            color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
                                                            show_colnames = TRUE,
                                                            main = "SSGSEA our RNA-seq terms (averaged replicates)")
ssgsea_mes_adr_ncc_noradr_heatmap_avg
```

## Analysis Summary and Session Information

```{r analysis_summary}
analysis_end_time <- Sys.time()
analysis_duration <- difftime(analysis_end_time, analysis_start_time, units = "mins")

# Create comprehensive summary report
summary_report <- data.frame(
  Analysis = c("TDI vs DMSO", "doxTDI vs dox"),
  Significant_Genes = c(
    nrow(deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO$results_signif),
    nrow(deg_results_doxTDI_vs_dox$results_signif)
  ),
  Upregulated = c(
    sum(deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO$results_signif$log2FoldChange > 0),
    sum(deg_results_doxTDI_vs_dox$results_signif$log2FoldChange > 0)
  ),
  Downregulated = c(
    sum(deg_results_TDI_vs_DMSO$results_signif$log2FoldChange < 0),
    sum(deg_results_doxTDI_vs_dox$results_signif$log2FoldChange < 0)
  ),
  Files_Generated = c(
    "WWTR1_TDI_vs_DMSO_analysis.xlsx",
    "WWTR1_doxTDI_vs_dox_analysis.xlsx"
  )
)

knitr::kable(summary_report, caption = "WWTR1 Overexpression Analysis Summary")

message("=== WWTR1 OVEREXPRESSION ANALYSIS COMPLETED ===")
```
